pairs.subject: node-boot-and-declarative-bootstrap
pairs.evidence: apps/console/src/app/main.tsx:17 This context's entry point is a browser SPA. It composes a hash router and a daemon-client data layer (compose.ts) and mounts React, so it holds no durable state, no seal boundary, no reload signal and no first-start privileged bootstrap. A search of apps/console/src/app, keys and kit for unseal, SIGHUP, reloadable and restartRequired returned nothing; the one hit for 'bootstrap' is the context's own name in a keymap.test.ts comment.

techniques.evidence: apps/console/src/app/compose.ts:1 Client composition root with no storage-open, unseal or listener-bind step. The technique's own exclusion covers graphs without an unseal-shaped step.
apps/console/src/app/compose.ts:15 Config is read from the URL, env and shell daemon on every page load. No first-start privileged sequence and no root credential exist here.
apps/console/src/app/main.tsx:12 A browser reload is a full restart with no in-flight node state, which is the technique's own exclusion.
apps/console/src/app/compose.ts:18 No device can be created both from config and through an API in this context. The console is only a client of the daemon.
apps/console/src/app/compose.ts:10 No seal or pluggable key-unwrapping provider. The client's only dependencies are a socket and timers.
